verdict.rationale: Blaxel offers point-in-time sandbox snapshots with rollback to a checkpoint (blaxel-docs-21) and per-run execution history for scheduled commands (blaxel-docs-26). Config lives in blaxel.toml and can be deployed through an official GitHub Action (blaxel-docs-6, blaxel-docs-13), which suggests git-based versioning. However, none of this is documented as versioning, review, or rollback of deployed automations (agents, jobs, schedules) themselves. Missing for 10: native revision history for deployed agents/jobs, a review/approval or diff workflow, one-click rollback of automation deployments, and independent corroboration.
